Interface RBackend

All Superinterfaces:
com.eco.bio7.rbridge.REvaluator
public interface RBackend extends com.eco.bio7.rbridge.REvaluator
The connection of Bio7 to R: embedded R, in the process of Bio7. Evaluations return an RValue (plugin com.eco.bio7.rffm), errors of R are an RException.
